name: collabsales-planner
description: A build-free prototype that revamps the KULT Planning Engine's build-plan flow into a Collabrium surface: the App Shell (sidebar nav ported from the mothership's landing-v3/feedback-v1 pages, department switcher set to Sales) plus a restructured 4-step campaign wizard with a persistent live rail. The design spec, including the audit of the live app it answers, is at `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-27-collabsales-planner-design.md`.
